session_of.reason: March 19-21, 2021 was one three-day dual meet, not three meets. Wabash's page lists three wins (Mar 19 59-32, Mar 20 163-76, Mar 21 231-120), but its own recaps describe the first two as the running score of the same meet ("after the first day", "the second day of competition") and the last as the final of "the three-day competition", 231-120. DePauw's page lists one meet, on Mar 21 (120-231). The two earlier rows are in-progress session scores, so they are set aside and the Mar 21 row matches DePauw's normally.
